BO-32

BODY — Back Door Glass

2. REMOVE FOLLOWING PARTS:
(a) Rear wiper arm
(b) Window defogger wire connector

3. REMOVE GLASS
(a) If reusing the weatherstrip:
Working from the vehicle outside with a screwdriver,
loosen the weatherstrip lip from the body.

Weatherstrip
Body

(b) If not reusing the weatherstrip:
From the outside, cut off the weatherstrip lip with a
knife.

(c) Force the weatherstrip lip from the interior to the
body flange outside. Pull the glass outwards and
remove it with the weatherstrip.

Weatherstrip
Body
